steps.en: Copy the cleanup DAG file into your Airflow dags folder
steps.zh: 把清理 DAG 文件拷进 Airflow 的 dags 目录

steps.en: Edit the globals at the top: schedule, owner, alert emails, whether to delete
steps.zh: 改文件顶部的全局变量：调度频率、负责人、告警邮箱、是否真删

steps.en: Set the retention age as an Airflow Variable, then enable the DAG
steps.zh: 在 Airflow Variables 里设保留天数，然后启用 DAG

steps.en: Runs on Airflow's own scheduler (@daily by default) and computes the cutoff date
steps.zh: 由 Airflow 自己的调度器跑（默认每天），先算出截止日期

steps.en: Deletes DagRun, TaskInstance, Log, XCom and other rows older than the cutoff
steps.zh: 删掉早于截止日期的运行、任务、日志、XCom 等记录

value.en: The metadata DB stops growing without you writing and testing your own DELETE SQL
value.zh: 元数据库不再无限膨胀，而且不用自己写、自己测 DELETE SQL

sources: https://github.com/teamclairvoyant/airflow-maintenance-dags/blob/master/db-cleanup/README.md (Deploy steps: wget the file, update SCHEDULE_INTERVAL / DAG_OWNER_NAME / ALERT_EMAIL_ADDRESSES / ENABLE_DELETE, set Variable airflow_db_cleanup__max_db_entry_age_in_days, enable the DAG)
db-cleanup/airflow-db-cleanup.py (SCHEDULE_INTERVAL = "@daily", ENABLE_DELETE = True, models DagRun/TaskInstance/Log/XCom/SlaMiss imported from airflow.models)
